decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Application form, Design and Access Statement, HLP/497/01B, HLP/497/03B, HLP/497/05B, Received 5 August 2013, HLP/497/104F, HLP/497/105F, Received 10 September 2013  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The rating level of any noise generated by plant & equipment as part of the development shall be at least 10 dB below the pre-existing background level as determined by BS4142: 1997-"Method of rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas".

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Reason. To accord with the provisions of Section 92 (1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
description: Installation of new shopfront and replacement of two air conditioning units.
